description: I'm interested on how to solve social and economic problems using ancient and modern methods and technology.
summary: I build an interactive map that utilize NISAR data that easy to use for everyday people. Radar data is hard for most people to interpret, including myself. As I learn about NISAR a little bit, I think I can make a web app that can somewhat help people to understand surface movements and possible surface type using SAR data. I successfully building an MVP that show surface change on a part of a Town, Senadin, Sarawak, Malaysia.
details:
This web app allow user to use NISAR data like using google map. It can show surface changes with some simplified interpretation and relatively easy to understand for everyday people like me.

I want people easily find creative way to use NISAR data without having to understand much about it. Like when I use AI to build the app, I'm not even good at coding. One use that I find myself fascinated about is finding out that i can see if an area flooded without even going there. The surface change visible through interpretation function the web app has.

I myself mostly using my phone and laptop to chat communicate with chatgpt. I use some software that I custom built using chatgpt in the past like my custom MCP https://mcp.ragaijau.shop/ and my DevBox server https://13.62.28.86/ where i can let chatgpt work anytime when my laptop offline. It uses AWS hosting server, and consuming my free AWS credits. These things makes me consider that I can build this app within short time (imperfectly).

On chatGpt part, I'm not sure everything that it used.
